source.text: נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: [Is] to be chosen a name more than riches great; more than silver and more than gold favor [is] good.

en.L: A [good] name [is] to be chosen rather than great riches; \q favor [is] better than silver and than gold.
en.B: A good reputation is worth choosing over great wealth; \q being well regarded is better than silver and gold.
en.R: Being known as a good person is worth more than being very rich. \q Being respected is better than having silver and gold.

fr.L: Un [bon] nom [est] préférable à de grandes richesses ; \q la faveur [vaut] mieux que l’argent et que l’or.
fr.B: Une bonne réputation vaut mieux que de grandes richesses ; \q être estimé vaut mieux que l’argent et l’or.
fr.R: Être connu comme quelqu’un de bien vaut plus qu’être très riche. \q Être respecté vaut mieux qu’avoir de l’argent et de l’or.

sw.L: Jina [jema] [ni] la kuchaguliwa kuliko mali nyingi; \q kibali [ni] bora kuliko fedha na kuliko dhahabu.
sw.B: Sifa njema inafaa kuchaguliwa kuliko utajiri mwingi; \q kuheshimiwa ni bora kuliko fedha na dhahabu.
sw.R: Kujulikana kuwa mtu mwema kuna thamani kuliko kuwa tajiri sana. \q Kuheshimiwa ni bora kuliko kuwa na fedha na dhahabu.

es.L: Más digno de elegirse [es el buen] nombre que las grandes riquezas; \q el favor [es] mejor que la plata y que el oro.
es.B: Una buena reputación vale más que una gran fortuna; \q ser bien estimado es mejor que la plata y el oro.
es.R: Ser conocido como una buena persona vale más que ser muy rico. \q Ser respetado es mejor que tener plata y oro.

vi.L: Danh [tốt] đáng chọn hơn của cải nhiều; \q ân huệ tốt hơn bạc và hơn vàng.
vi.B: Danh tiếng tốt đáng chọn hơn giàu có lớn; \q được người quý mến tốt hơn bạc và vàng.
vi.R: Được biết đến là người tốt quý hơn giàu có. \q Được người khác tôn trọng tốt hơn có bạc và vàng.

ko.L: [좋은] 이름이 많은 재물보다 택할 만하고, \q 은총이 은보다, 금보다 낫다.
ko.B: 좋은 평판은 많은 재산보다 택할 만한 것이요, \q 사람들의 호감을 사는 것이 은이나 금보다 낫다.
ko.R: 좋은 사람으로 알려지는 것이 큰 부자가 되는 것보다 낫다. \q 존경받는 것이 은과 금을 가지는 것보다 낫다.

pt.L: Um [bom] nome [é] preferível a grandes riquezas; \q o favor [é] melhor que a prata e que o ouro.
pt.B: Vale a pena escolher o bom nome em vez de grande fortuna; \q a estima dos outros supera a prata e o ouro.
pt.R: Ter fama de boa pessoa vale mais do que ser muito rico. \q Ser respeitado é melhor do que ter prata e ouro.

am.L: [መልካም] ስም ከብዙ ሀብት ይልቅ የሚመረጥ [ነው]፤ \q ሞገስም ከብርና ከወርቅ ይሻላል።
am.B: መልካም ስም ከብዙ ሀብት ይልቅ ተመራጭ ነው፤ \q በሰው ዘንድ መከበርም ከብርና ከወርቅ ይበልጣል።
am.R: ደግ ሰው ተብሎ መታወቅ እጅግ ሀብታም ከመሆን ይበልጣል። \q መከበርም ብርና ወርቅ ከማግኘት ይሻላል።

hi.L: बड़े धन से [अच्छा] नाम चुनने योग्य [है]; \q चाँदी और सोने से कृपा अच्छी [है]।
hi.B: अच्छा नाम बड़े धन से बढ़कर चुनने योग्य है; \q लोगों की नज़र में भला होना चाँदी और सोने से अच्छा है।
hi.R: भले व्यक्ति के रूप में जाना जाना बहुत धनी होने से ज़्यादा मूल्यवान है। \q लोगों से आदर पाना चाँदी और सोना होने से अच्छा है।

ru.L: [Доброе] имя предпочтительнее большого богатства; \q благосклонность лучше серебра и золота.
ru.B: Доброе имя стоит выбрать, а не большое богатство; \q уважение лучше серебра и золота.
ru.R: Быть известным как хороший человек ценнее, чем быть очень богатым. \q Быть уважаемым лучше, чем иметь серебро и золото.

uk.L: [Добре] імʼя — варте вибору більше, ніж велике багатство; \q прихильність — краща за срібло й за золото.
uk.B: Добре імʼя варто обрати замість великого багатства; \q добра слава краща за срібло й золото.
uk.R: Бути відомим як добра людина варте більше, ніж бути дуже багатим. \q Бути шанованим краще, ніж мати срібло й золото.

decisions.choice: a name: a good reputation
decisions.reason: The bare word "name" here means a good name, the honor in which a person is held (Ecclesiastes 7:1).

decisions.choice: favor: the goodwill of others
decisions.reason: Favor (hen) is the kindness and respect others show a person (3:4; 13:15). With "more than", good means better.

decisions.choice: [good] name
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the word the Hebrew implies, in brackets.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Proverbs 22
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

A name here is a good reputation (meaning m1), so Literal supplies "good" in brackets, as the English does. Favour is the goodwill of others (meaning m2); Literal says "कृपा", Balanced and Readable say what it means.

source.text: עָשִׁ֣יר וָרָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Rich and poor meet together; [the] maker of all of them [is] YHWH.

en.L: [The] rich and [the] poor meet together; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is the] Maker of them all.
en.B: Rich and poor alike share one thing: \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is the maker of them all.
en.R: Rich people and poor people are alike in one way. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made every one of them.

fr.L: [Le] riche et [le] pauvre se rencontrent ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est le] Créateur de tous.
fr.B: Riches et pauvres ont ceci en commun : \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a tous faits.
fr.R: Les riches et les pauvres se ressemblent sur un point. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a tous créés.

sw.L: Tajiri na maskini hukutana; \q Muumba wao wote [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Tajiri na maskini wanashiriki jambo moja: \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye aliyewaumba wote.
sw.R: Matajiri na maskini wanafanana katika jambo moja. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye aliyemuumba kila mmoja wao.

es.L: [El] rico y [el] pobre se encuentran; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es el] Hacedor de todos ellos.
es.B: Ricos y pobres tienen algo en común: \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el creador de todos ellos.
es.R: Los ricos y los pobres se parecen en una cosa. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los hizo a todos.

vi.L: Người giàu và người nghèo gặp nhau; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đấng Tạo Hóa của tất cả họ.
vi.B: Người giàu và người nghèo có chung một điều: \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng dựng nên tất cả họ.
vi.R: Người giàu và người nghèo giống nhau ở một điểm. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên mỗi người trong họ.

ko.L: 부자와 가난한 자가 함께 만나니, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들 모두를 지으신 분이시다.
ko.B: 부자와 가난한 사람에게는 같은 것이 하나 있으니, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들 모두를 지으셨다는 것이다.
ko.R: 부자와 가난한 사람은 한 가지 점에서 똑같다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 다 만드셨다.

pt.L: O rico e o pobre se encontram; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é] o Criador de todos eles.
pt.B: Ricos e pobres têm algo em comum: \q foi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} quem fez a todos.
pt.R: Os ricos e os pobres são iguais numa coisa. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez cada um deles.

am.L: ሀብታምና ድሃ ይገናኛሉ፤ \q የሁሉም ሠሪ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነው]።
am.B: ሀብታምና ድሃ በአንድ ነገር ይመሳሰላሉ፤ \q የሁሉንም ፈጣሪ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።
am.R: ሀብታሞችና ድሆች በአንድ ነገር አንድ ናቸው። \q ሁሉንም የፈጠራቸው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።

hi.L: धनी और ग़रीब आपस में मिलते हैं; \q उन सब को बनानेवाले {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हैं]।
hi.B: धनी और ग़रीब में एक बात एक-सी है: \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उन सब के बनानेवाले हैं।
hi.R: धनी लोग और ग़रीब लोग एक बात में एक जैसे हैं। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उन सब में से हर एक को बनाया है।

ru.L: Богатый и бедный встречаются; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Создатель их всех.
ru.B: У богатого и бедного есть общее: \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — создатель их всех.
ru.R: Богатые и бедные люди в одном похожи. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} создал каждого из них.

uk.L: Багатий і бідний зустрічаються; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — Творець їх усіх.
uk.B: Багатого й бідного обʼєднує одне: \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} створив їх усіх.
uk.R: Багаті й бідні люди в одному схожі. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} створив кожного з них.

decisions.choice: meet together: have this in common
decisions.reason: The rich and the poor cross paths in life, and what they share is that the LORD made both (14:31; 17:5; 29:13; Job 31:15).

decisions.choice: have this in common / are alike in one way
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state what the meeting means, so the line does not sound like a chance encounter.

source.text: עָר֤וּם׀רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה וְנִסְתָּ֑ר וּ֝פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A sensible [person] sees evil and hides himself, and naive [people] pass on and are punished.

en.L: A sensible [person] sees trouble and hides {{gender:themselves|himself}}, \q but [the] simple pass on and pay the penalty.
en.B: Sensible people see danger coming and take cover, \q but the naive walk straight into it and suffer for it.
en.R: Wise people see danger ahead and get out of the way. \q But people who do not think ahead keep going and get hurt.

fr.L: [Celui qui est] avisé voit le malheur et se cache, \q mais [les] simples passent outre et en subissent la peine.
fr.B: Les gens avisés voient venir le danger et se mettent à l’abri, \q mais les naïfs foncent droit dedans et en souffrent.
fr.R: Les sages voient le danger devant eux et s’écartent. \q Mais ceux qui ne réfléchissent pas avancent et se font du mal.

sw.L: Mwerevu huona hatari akajificha, \q bali wajinga huendelea mbele wakapata adhabu.
sw.B: Wenye akili huona hatari ikija wakajificha, \q bali wajinga hujitumbukiza ndani yake wakaumia.
sw.R: Watu wenye akili huona hatari mbele yao wakaikwepa. \q Lakini watu wanaodanganywa kwa urahisi huendelea bila kufikiri, wakaumia.

es.L: El sensato ve el mal y se esconde, \q pero [los] simples siguen adelante y pagan las consecuencias.
es.B: La gente sensata ve venir el peligro y se pone a cubierto, \q pero los ingenuos se meten de lleno en él y lo sufren.
es.R: Los sabios ven el peligro y se apartan del camino. \q Pero los que se dejan engañar siguen adelante y salen lastimados.

vi.L: Người khôn khéo thấy tai họa thì ẩn mình, \q nhưng [người] khờ dại cứ đi tới và phải chịu hình phạt.
vi.B: Người khôn khéo thấy nguy hiểm đến thì tìm chỗ núp, \q còn người khờ dại cứ đi thẳng vào và chịu khổ.
vi.R: Người khôn ngoan thấy nguy hiểm phía trước thì tránh đi. \q Nhưng người không biết suy nghĩ trước cứ đi tới và bị hại.

ko.L: 슬기로운 자는 재앙을 보고 몸을 숨기지만, \q 어리석은 자들은 지나가다가 벌을 받는다.
ko.B: 슬기로운 사람은 위험이 오는 것을 보고 피하지만, \q 순진한 사람은 곧장 걸어 들어가 해를 입는다.
ko.R: 슬기로운 사람은 앞에 있는 위험을 보고 비켜 간다. \q 그러나 앞일을 생각하지 않는 사람은 그냥 가다가 다친다.

pt.L: O prudente vê o mal e se esconde, \q mas os ingênuos passam adiante e pagam a pena.
pt.B: Quem é prudente vê o perigo chegando e se protege, \q mas os ingênuos seguem em frente e sofrem as consequências.
pt.R: Os sábios veem o perigo à frente e saem do caminho. \q Mas quem não pensa no futuro continua andando e se machuca.

am.L: ብልህ ክፉን ያያል፤ ይሸሸጋል፤ \q አላዋቂዎች ያልፋሉ፤ ይቀጣሉ።
am.B: ብልህ ሰው ጥፋት ሲመጣ አይቶ ይሸሸጋል፤ \q አላዋቂዎች ግን ዝም ብለው ይቀጥላሉ፤ ጉዳቱንም ይቀበላሉ።
am.R: ብልህ ሰዎች አደጋን አይተው ከመንገድ ይርቃሉ። \q አስቀድመው የማያስቡ ሰዎች ግን ዝም ብለው ይሄዳሉ፤ ይጎዳሉም።

hi.L: चतुर [मनुष्य] विपत्ति को देखकर छिप जाता है, \q पर भोले आगे बढ़ते जाते हैं और दंड भोगते हैं।
hi.B: चतुर लोग ख़तरे को आते देखकर आड़ ले लेते हैं, \q पर भोले सीधे उसमें जा पड़ते हैं और उसका दुख उठाते हैं।
hi.R: बुद्धिमान लोग आगे ख़तरा देखकर रास्ते से हट जाते हैं। \q पर आसानी से बहकनेवाले लोग चलते रहते हैं और चोट खाते हैं।

ru.L: Благоразумный видит беду и укрывается, \q а простаки идут дальше и платятся.
ru.B: Благоразумные видят опасность и прячутся, \q а наивные идут прямо на неё и страдают.
ru.R: Мудрые люди замечают опасность заранее и уходят с дороги. \q А легковерные идут дальше и попадают в беду.

uk.L: Розважливий бачить лихо й ховається, \q а простаки йдуть далі й платять за це.
uk.B: Розважливі люди бачать, що наближається небезпека, і ховаються, \q а наївні йдуть просто на неї й страждають.
uk.R: Мудрі люди бачать небезпеку попереду й сходять з дороги. \q А люди, які не думають наперед, ідуть далі й зазнають шкоди.

decisions.choice: and hides himself, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The reading the scribes marked adds "and" to the verb; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: almost the same as 27:12
decisions.reason: 27:12 repeats this saying with small differences in the joining words.

decisions.choice: people who do not think ahead
decisions.reason: Readable describes the simple (petayim) instead of naming them.

decisions.choice: this wording, to be repeated in 27:12
decisions.reason: 27:12 repeats this saying with small differences in the joining words (m2). It is drafted here first; 27:12 should keep these words wherever its Hebrew is the same. 'arum is "o prudente" (13:16) and pethi "o ingênuo", as the book has them.

decisions.choice: the sensible (ʿarum) as "ብልህ", the simple (peti) as "አላዋቂ"
decisions.reason: "ብልህ" is the shrewd, careful person, the word the terms list uses for prudence (ʿormah, "ብልሃት"), kept apart from "ጠቢብ" (wise, ḥakham). "አላዋቂ" is the terms list's word for the inexperienced who believe anything; "የዋህ" would praise them. Readable says "አስቀድመው የማያስቡ ሰዎች" as the English Readable explains them. This saying returns in 27:12, and the two read alike (the Hebrew here adds "and" twice, which Amharic carries in the chain of verbs).

decisions.choice: no gender spans in this chapter: "ይሸሸጋል", "ነፍሱን", "በሥራው" with the generic masculine
alternatives: gender spans as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: In Amharic a saying about "whoever" takes the ordinary masculine singular, which is heard as anyone, man or woman, so the setting has no second wording to switch to (verses 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 16, 22, 25, 29).

decisions.choice: no gender span; "चतुर", "भोले" (L, B), "आसानी से बहकनेवाले" (R)
alternatives: a gender span on the pronoun
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "themselves" or "himself"; the Hindi "छिप जाता है" has no pronoun for the setting to change, and the Hindi pronouns "वह", "उसका", "अपना" are the same for a man or a woman, so this chapter has no gender spans for them. The sensible are "चतुर", as prudence in 1:4, and the simple (peti) "भोले" at Literal and Balanced and "आसानी से बहकनेवाले" at Readable, as the poetry note settles. The proverb is repeated almost word for word at 27:12 (meaning m2); this wording is meant to be copied there.

decisions.choice: благоразумный; простак (L), наивный (B), легковерный (R)
decisions.reason: The saying returns almost word for word at 27:12 (m2), which is worded alike in Russian at each level. Peti is "простак" (L), "наивный" (B) and "легковерный" (R) as the Proverbs terms settle, at Readable too, where the English describes the simple.

source.text: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְכָב֣וֹד וְחַיִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] reward of humility, [the] fear of YHWH, [is] riches and honor and life.

en.L: [The] reward of humility [and] the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q [is] riches and honor and life.
en.B: Humility and the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bring their reward: \q riches, honor, and life.
en.R: Be humble and honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with awe. \q Then you will receive riches, honor, and life.

fr.L: [La] récompense de l’humilité [et de] la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q [c’est] la richesse, l’honneur et la vie.
fr.B: L’humilité et la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ont leur récompense : \q la richesse, l’honneur et la vie.
fr.R: Sois humble et honore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect. \q Alors tu recevras la richesse, l’honneur et la vie.

sw.L: Thawabu ya unyenyekevu [na] kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q [ni] utajiri na heshima na uzima.
sw.B: Unyenyekevu na kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huleta thawabu yake: \q utajiri, heshima, na uzima.
sw.R: Uwe mnyenyekevu na umheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu. \q Ndipo utakapopokea utajiri, heshima, na uzima.

es.L: [La] recompensa de la humildad [y] del temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} \q [es] riqueza, honra y vida.
es.B: La humildad y el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} traen su recompensa: \q riqueza, honra y vida.
es.R: Sé humilde y honra {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con reverencia. \q Entonces recibirás riqueza, honra y vida.

vi.L: Phần thưởng của sự khiêm nhường [và] sự kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q [là] giàu có, vinh dự và sự sống.
vi.B: Khiêm nhường và kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đem lại phần thưởng: \q giàu có, vinh dự và sự sống.
vi.R: Hãy khiêm nhường và tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Rồi bạn sẽ nhận được giàu có, vinh dự và sự sống.

ko.L: 겸손과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외함의 보상은 \q 부와 영예와 생명이다.
ko.B: 겸손과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외함에는 보상이 따르니, \q 곧 부와 영예와 생명이다.
ko.R: 겸손하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려운 마음으로 섬겨라. \q 그러면 부와 영예와 생명을 얻을 것이다.

pt.L: A recompensa da humildade, o temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q [é] riqueza, honra e vida.
pt.B: A humildade e o temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} trazem a sua recompensa: \q riqueza, honra e vida.
pt.R: Seja humilde e honre {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} com reverência. \q Então você vai receber riqueza, honra e vida.

am.L: የትሕትናና {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የመፍራት ዋጋ \q ሀብትና ክብር ሕይወትም [ነው]።
am.B: ትሕትናና {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መፍራት ዋጋ ያስገኛሉ፤ \q ይኸውም ሀብት፣ ክብርና ሕይወት ነው።
am.R: ትሑት ሁን፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}}ም በአክብሮት ፍራ። \q ያን ጊዜ ሀብትን፣ ክብርንና ሕይወትን ታገኛለህ።

hi.L: नम्रता [और] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भय का फल \q धन और आदर और जीवन [है]।
hi.B: नम्रता और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय अपना प्रतिफल लाते हैं: \q धन, आदर और जीवन।
hi.R: नम्र बनो और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आदर और भय मानो। \q तब तुम्हें धन, आदर और जीवन मिलेगा।

ru.L: Награда за смирение [и] страх перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}} — \q богатство, и честь, и жизнь.
ru.B: Смирение и страх перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}} приносят свою награду: \q богатство, честь и жизнь.
ru.R: Будь смиренным и с благоговением чти {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. \q Тогда ты получишь богатство, честь и жизнь.

uk.L: Нагорода смирення [і] страху {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|перед Ягве}} — \q багатство, і честь, і життя.
uk.B: Смирення і страх перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}} приносять свою нагороду: \q багатство, шану й життя.
uk.R: Будь смиренним і шануй {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} з благоговінням. \q Тоді ти отримаєш багатство, шану й життя.

decisions.choice: humility and the fear of the LORD: two linked virtues
alternatives: the reward of humility is the fear of the LORD, with riches, honor and life
decisions.reason: The two phrases stand side by side with no "and". They may be a pair (15:33 joins them), or the fear of the LORD may itself be the first reward of humility.

decisions.choice: reward: the result that follows
decisions.reason: The word (eqev) means what comes at the heel of something, its outcome (Psalm 19:12).

decisions.choice: the fear of the LORD as "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መፍራት"
decisions.reason: The terms list's wording: the plain verbal noun says what the Hebrew phrase means, the reverent awe that obeys; the Ge'ez compound is a church phrase that does not take the divine name setting.

decisions.choice: "फल" (L), "प्रतिफल" (B); the fear of the LORD as in 1:7
decisions.reason: The reward is the result that follows (meaning m2); Literal says "फल" (fruit, outcome), Balanced "प्रतिफल", the reward word of this translation. Humility and the fear of the LORD are two linked virtues (meaning m1), and the fear of the LORD keeps the forms of 1:7.

source.text: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שׁוֹמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ יִרְחַ֥ק מֵהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thorns, snares [are] in [the] way of [the] crooked; [one who] guards his soul will be far from them.

en.L: Thorns [and] snares [are] in [the] path of [the] crooked; \q whoever guards {{gender:their|his}} life will keep far from them.
en.B: Thorns and traps lie on the road of the crooked; \q whoever values their life stays well away from them.
en.R: Dishonest people walk a path full of thorns and traps. \q If you want to protect your life, stay away from that path.

fr.L: Épines [et] pièges [sont] sur [le] chemin du pervers ; \q qui garde son âme s’en tiendra loin.
fr.B: Épines et pièges jonchent la route de celui qui est tortueux ; \q qui tient à sa vie s’en écarte.
fr.R: Les gens malhonnêtes suivent un chemin plein d’épines et de pièges. \q Si tu veux protéger ta vie, reste loin de ce chemin.

sw.L: Miiba [na] mitego [iko] katika njia ya mpotovu; \q aihifadhiye nafsi yake atakaa mbali nayo.
sw.B: Miiba na mitego imetandazwa katika njia ya mpotovu; \q anayethamini maisha yake hukaa mbali nayo.
sw.R: Watu wadanganyifu hutembea katika njia iliyojaa miiba na mitego. \q Ukitaka kulinda maisha yako, kaa mbali na njia hiyo.

es.L: Espinos [y] trampas [hay] en [el] camino del perverso; \q quien guarda su vida se alejará de ellos.
es.B: Espinos y trampas cubren el camino del perverso; \q quien aprecia su vida se mantiene bien lejos de ellos.
es.R: Los deshonestos andan por un camino lleno de espinos y trampas. \q Si quieres proteger tu vida, aléjate de ese camino.

vi.L: Gai gốc [và] cạm bẫy [ở] trên đường của kẻ gian tà; \q ai gìn giữ linh hồn mình sẽ tránh xa chúng.
vi.B: Gai gốc và cạm bẫy đầy trên đường kẻ gian tà; \q ai quý mạng sống mình sẽ tránh thật xa.
vi.R: Kẻ gian dối đi trên con đường đầy gai và bẫy. \q Nếu bạn muốn bảo vệ mạng sống mình, hãy tránh xa con đường ấy.

ko.L: 비뚤어진 자의 길에는 가시와 올무가 [있으니], \q 자기 영혼을 지키는 자는 그것들을 멀리할 것이다.
ko.B: 비뚤어진 사람의 길에는 가시와 덫이 깔려 있으니, \q 자기 목숨을 아끼는 사람은 그것을 멀리한다.
ko.R: 정직하지 않은 사람은 가시와 덫이 가득한 길을 걷는다. \q 네 목숨을 지키고 싶으면 그 길을 멀리하여라.

pt.L: Espinhos [e] laços [estão] no caminho do perverso; \q quem guarda a sua vida ficará longe deles.
pt.B: Espinhos e armadilhas há no caminho do perverso; \q quem dá valor à vida fica bem longe deles.
pt.R: As pessoas desonestas andam por um caminho cheio de espinhos e armadilhas. \q Se você quer proteger a sua vida, fique longe desse caminho.

am.L: እሾህና ወጥመድ በጠማማ [ሰው] መንገድ [አለ]፤ \q ነፍሱን የሚጠብቅ ከእነርሱ ይርቃል።
am.B: በጠማማ ሰው መንገድ ላይ እሾህና ወጥመድ አለ፤ \q ለሕይወቱ የሚሳሳ ግን ከእነርሱ አጥብቆ ይርቃል።
am.R: ታማኝ ያልሆኑ ሰዎች የሚሄዱበት መንገድ እሾህና ወጥመድ የሞላበት ነው። \q ሕይወትህን መጠበቅ ከፈለግህ ከዚያ መንገድ ራቅ።

hi.L: टेढ़े के मार्ग में काँटे [और] फंदे [हैं]; \q जो अपने प्राण की रक्षा करता है, वह उनसे दूर रहेगा।
hi.B: टेढ़े लोगों की राह में काँटे और फंदे बिछे हैं; \q जिसे अपनी जान प्यारी है, वह उनसे दूर ही रहता है।
hi.R: बेईमान लोग काँटों और फंदों से भरे रास्ते पर चलते हैं। \q यदि तुम अपने जीवन की रक्षा करना चाहते हो, तो उस रास्ते से दूर रहो।

ru.L: Терны [и] силки на пути лукавого; \q хранящий свою душу будет далёк от них.
ru.B: Терновник и ловушки лежат на дороге лукавого; \q кто дорожит своей жизнью, держится от них подальше.
ru.R: Нечестные люди идут по дороге, полной колючек и ловушек. \q Если хочешь сберечь свою жизнь, держись подальше от этой дороги.

uk.L: Терни [й] сильця — на дорозі кривого; \q хто береже свою душу, буде далеко від них.
uk.B: Терни й пастки лежать на дорозі кривих; \q хто цінує своє життя, тримається від них подалі.
uk.R: Нечесні люди ходять стежкою, повною терня й пасток. \q Якщо хочеш уберегти своє життя, тримайся подалі від тієї стежки.

decisions.choice: thorns and snares: the troubles of a crooked life
decisions.reason: The crooked person's road is painful and dangerous (15:19). Whoever guards their life keeps off it (16:17; 19:16).

source.text: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭נַּעַר עַל־פִּ֣י דַרְכּ֑וֹ גַּ֥ם כִּֽי־יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹֽא־יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Train the youth according to [the] mouth of his way; even when he grows old he will not turn from it.

en.L: Train a child according to {{gender:their|his}} way; \q even when {{gender:they grow|he grows}} old, {{gender:they|he}} will not turn from it.
en.B: Start children off on the way they should go, \q and even when they are old they will not leave it.
en.R: Teach children the right way to live while they are young. \q When they grow old, they will still live that way.

fr.L: Forme l’enfant selon sa voie ; \q même quand il sera vieux, il ne s’en détournera pas.
fr.B: Mets l’enfant sur le chemin qu’il doit suivre, \q et même devenu vieux, il ne le quittera pas.
fr.R: Apprends aux enfants à bien vivre pendant qu’ils sont jeunes. \q Quand ils seront vieux, ils vivront encore de cette façon.

sw.L: Mzoeshe kijana kulingana na njia yake; \q hata atakapozeeka, hatageuka kuiacha.
sw.B: Mwanzishe mtoto katika njia anayopaswa kuiendea, \q naye hata akiwa mzee hatatoka katika njia hiyo.
sw.R: Mfundishe mtoto njia iliyo sawa ya kuishi angali mdogo. \q Atakapozeeka, bado ataishi hivyo.

es.L: Inicia al muchacho según su camino; \q aun cuando envejezca, no se desviará de él.
es.B: Pon a los niños en marcha por el camino que deben seguir, \q y aun de viejos no lo dejarán.
es.R: Enséñales a los niños a vivir bien mientras son pequeños. \q Cuando sean mayores, seguirán viviendo así.

vi.L: Hãy huấn luyện đứa trẻ theo đường lối của nó; \q dù khi già, nó cũng không lìa bỏ đường ấy.
vi.B: Hãy dạy trẻ từ thuở đầu theo con đường nó phải đi, \q thì dù đến khi già, nó cũng không rời bỏ.
vi.R: Hãy dạy trẻ em cách sống đúng khi các em còn nhỏ. \q Khi về già, các em vẫn sẽ sống như vậy.

ko.L: 아이를 그의 길에 맞게 가르쳐라. \q 그러면 늙어서도 그것을 떠나지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 아이에게 마땅히 가야 할 길을 처음부터 가르쳐라. \q 그러면 늙어서도 그 길을 떠나지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 아이가 어릴 때 바르게 사는 법을 가르쳐라. \q 그러면 늙어서도 그렇게 살 것이다.

pt.L: Inicie a criança conforme o caminho dela; \q mesmo quando envelhecer, não se afastará dele.
pt.B: Ponha a criança desde cedo na estrada por onde ela deve ir, \q e mesmo depois de velha ela não vai deixá-la.
pt.R: Ensine as crianças a viver do jeito certo enquanto são pequenas. \q Quando ficarem velhas, vão continuar vivendo assim.

am.L: ልጅን እንደ መንገዱ አሠልጥን፤ \q ባረጀም ጊዜ እንኳ ከእርሱ ዘወር አይልም።
am.B: ልጆችን በሚገባቸው መንገድ ላይ አስጀምራቸው፤ \q ባረጁም ጊዜ ከእርሱ አይወጡም።
am.R: ልጆች ገና ትንሽ ሳሉ ትክክለኛውን የአኗኗር መንገድ አስተምራቸው። \q ባረጁም ጊዜ በዚያው መንገድ ይኖራሉ።

hi.L: बालक को उसके मार्ग के अनुसार सधाओ; \q वह बूढ़ा होने पर भी उससे नहीं मुड़ेगा।
hi.B: बच्चों को उसी राह पर चलना शुरू कराओ जिस पर उन्हें चलना है, \q और बूढ़े होने पर भी वे उसे नहीं छोड़ेंगे।
hi.R: बच्चों को छोटी उम्र में ही जीने का सही तरीक़ा सिखाओ। \q जब वे बूढ़े होंगे, तब भी वे उसी तरह जिएँगे।

ru.L: Наставляй ребёнка сообразно его пути; \q даже когда он состарится, не свернёт с него.
ru.B: Направь детей на путь, по которому им следует идти, \q и даже в старости они не сойдут с него.
ru.R: Учи детей правильно жить, пока они маленькие. \q Когда они состарятся, они будут жить так же.

uk.L: Привчай дитину відповідно до її дороги; \q навіть коли постаріє, не відступить від неї.
uk.B: Спрямуй дітей на дорогу, якою їм слід іти, \q і навіть коли постаріють, вони з неї не зійдуть.
uk.R: Навчай дітей правильно жити, поки вони малі. \q Коли постаріють, вони й далі так житимуть.

decisions.choice: according to his way: the way he ought to go
alternatives: the way suited to the child's own nature and stage of life
the way the child wants to go, said as a warning: let a child have his own way and he will never leave it
decisions.reason: "According to the mouth of his way" means "in keeping with his way", but whose standard sets the way is not stated. Proverbs speaks of one right way of wisdom (4:11), so the way he should go is taken here; the phrase can also mean training fitted to the child, or, less likely, a warning against leaving a child to himself (29:15).

decisions.choice: train: start off, dedicate
decisions.reason: The verb (hanak) is used of dedicating a house or the temple (Deuteronomy 20:5; 1 Kings 8:63): to begin something in the direction it is meant to go.

decisions.choice: child: a youth, boy or girl, from infancy to young adulthood
decisions.reason: The word (naar) covers a baby (1 Samuel 4:21) up to a young man (Genesis 37:2). The saying applies to any child; like other proverbs it states what usually happens rather than a promise.

decisions.choice: their / his
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pronoun is masculine but the saying is about any child, so Literal offers the inclusive and traditional pronoun as a setting.

decisions.choice: "l'enfant ... sa voie ... il", with no gender span where the English Literal has "their|his"
decisions.reason: French "enfant" already means a boy or a girl (meaning decision m3), and "sa" and "il" that refer back to it are ordinary generic French, so no setting is needed (French style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: "mzoeshe" (accustom him) at Literal, "mwanzishe" (start him off) at Balanced
decisions.reason: The verb is used of dedicating a house, setting something going in the direction it is meant to go (meaning decision m2); "mwanzishe" says that beginning. The wording also keeps this well-known verse clear of the familiar Swahili versions.

decisions.choice: "nó" for the child, with no gender span
alternatives: gender spans as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: "nó" is the ordinary word for a child, boy or girl, so Vietnamese has no second form for the setting, as with "người" and "của mình" (12:8).

decisions.choice: Inicie (L); Ponha ... desde cedo na estrada (B)
decisions.reason: Drafted from the Hebrew, away from the familiar wording of this verse ("no caminho em que deve andar"). hanak is to start something off in the direction it is meant to go (m2), so Literal says "Inicie" and Balanced "Ponha ... desde cedo na estrada por onde ela deve ir"; "ensinar" only teaches, and is left to Readable, which follows the English "Teach".

decisions.choice: a criança ... dela (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The English Literal puts the pronouns under the gender setting (r-en-1) because the saying is about any child (m3). Portuguese "a criança" already means a boy or a girl, and "dela" agrees with that noun, so the line is inclusive without a setting; "o menino" would narrow it.

decisions.choice: "ከእርሱ ዘወር አይልም" (he will not turn aside from it)
decisions.reason: The verb (sur) is to turn aside; "ዘወር አለ" says it plainly. The other wording is the one most readers remember from an older Amharic Bible, and this verse is drafted fresh from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "सधाओ" (L); "चलना शुरू कराओ" (B); "बालक" (L), "बच्चों" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to start off or dedicate (meaning m2), and "his way" is the way he ought to go (meaning m1); Literal keeps "according to his way", Balanced says "the way they should go", as the English. The youth may be a boy or a girl of any age to young adulthood (meaning m3), so Balanced and Readable say "children". The wording is drafted from the Hebrew, not from a familiar Hindi version.

decisions.choice: "ребёнка ... его" without a gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers an inclusive pronoun as a setting; Russian "ребёнок" is used of any child and takes "его" by grammar, so the line is already inclusive and needs no span. Balanced and Readable say "дети".

source.text: עָ֭שִׁיר בְּרָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשׁ֑וֹל וְעֶ֥בֶד לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: A rich [one] over [the] poor rules, and a servant [is the] borrower to [the] man [who] lends.

en.L: [The] rich rule over [the] poor, \q and [the] borrower [is] a slave to [the] one who lends.
en.B: The rich lord it over the poor, \q and whoever borrows becomes the lender's slave.
en.R: Rich people have power over poor people. \q If you borrow money, you come under the control of the one who lent it.

fr.L: [Le] riche domine sur [les] pauvres, \q et [celui qui] emprunte [est] esclave de celui qui prête.
fr.B: Le riche fait la loi aux pauvres, \q et qui emprunte devient l’esclave du prêteur.
fr.R: Les riches ont du pouvoir sur les pauvres. \q Si tu empruntes de l’argent, tu dépends de celui qui te l’a prêté.

sw.L: Tajiri huwatawala maskini, \q na akopaye [ni] mtumwa wa yule akopeshaye.
sw.B: Matajiri huwatawala maskini kwa mabavu, \q na anayekopa huwa mtumwa wa anayemkopesha.
sw.R: Matajiri wana mamlaka juu ya maskini. \q Ukikopa fedha, unakuwa chini ya mamlaka ya yule aliyekukopesha.

es.L: [El] rico gobierna sobre [los] pobres, \q y [el] que pide prestado [es] esclavo del que presta.
es.B: Los ricos dominan a los pobres, \q y el que pide prestado se vuelve esclavo del que le presta.
es.R: Los ricos tienen poder sobre los pobres. \q Si pides dinero prestado, quedas bajo el control del que te lo prestó.

vi.L: Người giàu cai trị người nghèo, \q và người đi vay [là] nô lệ của người cho vay.
vi.B: Người giàu thống trị người nghèo, \q và ai đi vay trở thành nô lệ của người cho vay.
vi.R: Người giàu có quyền trên người nghèo. \q Nếu bạn vay tiền, bạn phải chịu sự sai khiến của người cho vay.

ko.L: 부자는 가난한 자들을 다스리고, \q 빌리는 자는 빌려주는 사람의 종이 [된다].
ko.B: 부자는 가난한 사람을 마음대로 부리고, \q 빚진 사람은 빌려준 사람의 종이 된다.
ko.R: 부자는 가난한 사람 위에 힘을 휘두른다. \q 돈을 빌리면 빌려준 사람에게 매이게 된다.

pt.L: O rico governa os pobres, \q e quem pede emprestado [é] escravo do homem que empresta.
pt.B: Os ricos mandam nos pobres, \q e quem toma empréstimo vira escravo de quem emprestou.
pt.R: Os ricos têm poder sobre os pobres. \q Se você pede dinheiro emprestado, fica nas mãos de quem emprestou.

am.L: ሀብታም ድሆችን ይገዛል፤ \q ተበዳሪም ለአበዳሪ ሰው ባሪያ [ነው]።
am.B: ሀብታሞች በድሆች ላይ ይሠለጥናሉ፤ \q የሚበደርም የአበዳሪው ባሪያ ይሆናል።
am.R: ሀብታሞች በድሆች ላይ ሥልጣን አላቸው። \q ገንዘብ ብትበደር ባበደረህ ሰው ቁጥጥር ሥር ትወድቃለህ።

hi.L: धनी ग़रीबों पर प्रभुता करता है, \q और उधार लेनेवाला उधार देनेवाले का दास [होता है]।
hi.B: धनी ग़रीबों पर हुक्म चलाते हैं, \q और जो उधार लेता है, वह उधार देनेवाले का दास बन जाता है।
hi.R: धनी लोगों का ग़रीब लोगों पर अधिकार होता है। \q यदि तुम पैसा उधार लेते हो, तो तुम उधार देनेवाले के वश में आ जाते हो।

ru.L: Богатый господствует над бедными, \q и должник — раб заимодавца.
ru.B: Богатые властвуют над бедными, \q а кто берёт в долг, становится рабом заимодавца.
ru.R: У богатых есть власть над бедными. \q Если ты берёшь деньги в долг, ты попадаешь в зависимость от того, кто их дал.

uk.L: Багатий панує над бідними, \q а позичальник — раб тому, хто позичає.
uk.B: Багаті панують над бідними, \q а хто позичає, стає рабом позикодавця.
uk.R: Багаті люди мають владу над бідними. \q Якщо позичаєш гроші, ти потрапляєш під владу того, хто їх позичив.

decisions.choice: the borrower is a slave: debt could end in servitude
decisions.reason: A debtor who could not pay might be sold, or have his children sold, to work off the debt (2 Kings 4:1; Nehemiah 5:5; Amos 2:6).

decisions.choice: slave
decisions.reason: "Slave" in Literal and Balanced, as the style guide keeps it where people are sold or held for debt: the word (eved) here describes a debtor's real loss of freedom (m1).

decisions.choice: "mtumwa" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Swahili follows the English here: a debtor could be held or sold for debt (meaning decision m1), so Balanced keeps "mtumwa" (slave) instead of "mtumishi".

decisions.choice: "दास"
decisions.reason: Debt could end in servitude (meaning m1), so the borrower is a slave, "दास", as the English Literal and Balanced say; Readable says he comes under the lender's control, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: раб
decisions.reason: Eved here is a debtor's real servitude (m1); Literal and Balanced say "раб", as the English keeps "slave".

source.text: זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה יִקְצָר־אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣וֹ יִכְלֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [One who] sows injustice will reap trouble, and the rod of his fury will come to an end.

en.L: Whoever sows injustice will reap trouble, \q and the rod of {{gender:their|his}} fury will come to an end.
en.B: Those who sow injustice will reap disaster, \q and the rod they swing in anger will fail.
en.R: People who do wrong will get trouble back, the way a farmer gets back the crop that was planted. \q The power they used in anger will be taken away.

fr.L: Qui sème l’injustice moissonnera le malheur, \q et la verge de sa fureur prendra fin.
fr.B: Ceux qui sèment l’injustice récolteront le désastre, \q et le bâton qu’ils brandissent avec colère se brisera.
fr.R: Ceux qui font le mal récolteront des ennuis, comme un paysan récolte ce qu’il a semé. \q Le pouvoir dont ils se servaient avec colère leur sera enlevé.

sw.L: Apandaye udhalimu atavuna taabu, \q na fimbo ya ghadhabu yake itakoma.
sw.B: Wanaopanda udhalimu watavuna maafa, \q na fimbo wanayoipunga kwa hasira itashindwa.
sw.R: Watu wanaotenda mabaya watavuna taabu, kama mkulima anavyovuna mazao aliyoyapanda. \q Uwezo waliotumia kwa hasira utaondolewa.

es.L: Quien siembra injusticia cosechará desgracia, \q y la vara de su furor llegará a su fin.
es.B: Los que siembran injusticia cosecharán desastre, \q y la vara que blanden con ira les fallará.
es.R: Los que hacen el mal recibirán problemas, como el campesino recoge lo que sembró. \q El poder que usaron con enojo les será quitado.

vi.L: Ai gieo sự bất công sẽ gặt tai họa, \q và cây roi giận dữ của nó sẽ chấm dứt.
vi.B: Kẻ gieo bất công sẽ gặt tai họa, \q và cây roi nó vung lên trong cơn giận sẽ gãy.
vi.R: Người làm điều sai trái sẽ nhận lại rắc rối, như nhà nông gặt lại mùa màng mình đã gieo. \q Quyền lực họ dùng trong cơn giận sẽ bị cất đi.

ko.L: 불의를 뿌리는 자는 재앙을 거둘 것이요, \q 그의 분노의 막대기는 끝장날 것이다.
ko.B: 불의를 심는 사람은 재앙을 거두고, \q 그가 화가 나서 휘두르던 몽둥이는 꺾일 것이다.
ko.R: 농부가 심은 대로 거두듯이, 잘못을 행하는 사람은 그대로 어려움을 돌려받는다. \q 화가 나서 휘두르던 힘도 빼앗길 것이다.

pt.L: Quem semeia a injustiça colherá a desgraça, \q e a vara da sua fúria chegará ao fim.
pt.B: Quem semeia injustiça colhe desastre, \q e a vara que ergue com raiva vai falhar.
pt.R: Quem faz o mal vai receber de volta problemas, como o lavrador colhe o que plantou. \q O poder que usava com raiva será tirado dele.

am.L: ግፍን የሚዘራ መከራን ያጭዳል፤ \q የቁጣውም በትር ያልቃል።
am.B: ግፍን የሚዘሩ ጥፋትን ያጭዳሉ፤ \q በቁጣ የሚያነሡትም በትር ከንቱ ይሆናል።
am.R: ክፉ የሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ገበሬ የዘራውን እንደሚያጭድ መከራን መልሰው ያገኛሉ። \q በቁጣ የተጠቀሙበትም ኃይል ይወሰድባቸዋል።

hi.L: जो अन्याय बोता है, वह विपत्ति काटेगा, \q और उसके रोष की छड़ी मिट जाएगी।
hi.B: जो अन्याय बोते हैं, वे विनाश काटेंगे, \q और जो छड़ी वे क्रोध में चलाते हैं, वह टूट जाएगी।
hi.R: जो लोग ग़लत काम करते हैं, उन्हें बदले में मुसीबत मिलेगी, जैसे किसान वही फ़सल काटता है जो उसने बोई थी। \q जो शक्ति उन्होंने क्रोध में चलाई, वह उनसे छीन ली जाएगी।

ru.L: Сеющий неправду пожнёт беду, \q и жезл его ярости исчезнет.
ru.B: Кто сеет несправедливость, пожнёт несчастье, \q и палка, которой он замахивается в гневе, сломается.
ru.R: Кто делает зло, получит беду в ответ, как крестьянин получает урожай того, что посеял. \q Власть, которую он применял в гневе, у него отнимут.

uk.L: Хто сіє несправедливість, пожне біду, \q і різка його люті скінчиться.
uk.B: Ті, хто сіє несправедливість, пожнуть лихо, \q і різка, якою вони розмахують у гніві, зламається.
uk.R: Люди, які чинять погане, отримають у відповідь біду, як хлібороб збирає те, що посіяв. \q Владу, якою вони користувалися в гніві, буде відібрано.

decisions.choice: will reap, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the rod of his fury will fail: his power to oppress will end
alternatives: the rod of God's fury will finish him
decisions.reason: The rod is the oppressor's means of beating others. The verb (kalah) can mean "come to an end" or "bring to an end", so the line may also say that his punishment will destroy him.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew ends the saying here
alternatives: the Greek translation adds: God blesses a cheerful and generous man
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation (the Septuagint) adds a line after this verse, which Paul echoes in 2 Corinthians 9:7. It is not in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: the way a farmer gets back the crop that was planted
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the picture of sowing and reaping.

decisions.choice: "उसके रोष की छड़ी मिट जाएगी" (L)
decisions.reason: The rod of his fury coming to an end means his power to oppress will fail (meaning m2); Literal keeps the image and Readable says what it means. The Hebrew ends the saying here (meaning m3).

source.text: טֽוֹב־עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: [One] good of eye, he will be blessed, for he gives from his bread to the poor.

en.L: [One with a] good eye will be blessed, \q for {{gender:they give|he gives}} from {{gender:their|his}} bread to the poor.
en.B: Generous people will be blessed, \q because they share their food with the poor.
en.R: People who give freely will be blessed. \q They share their food with poor people.

fr.L: [Celui qui a] l’œil bon sera béni, \q car il donne de son pain au pauvre.
fr.B: Les gens généreux seront bénis, \q parce qu’ils partagent leur pain avec le pauvre.
fr.R: Ceux qui donnent volontiers seront bénis. \q Ils partagent leur nourriture avec les pauvres.

sw.L: [Mwenye] jicho jema atabarikiwa, \q kwa maana huwapa maskini katika mkate wake.
sw.B: Watu wakarimu watabarikiwa, \q kwa sababu huwagawia maskini chakula chao.
sw.R: Watu wanaotoa kwa ukarimu watabarikiwa. \q Huwagawia watu maskini chakula chao.

es.L: [El de] ojo bueno será bendecido, \q porque da de su pan al pobre.
es.B: Los generosos serán bendecidos, \q porque comparten su comida con los pobres.
es.R: Los que dan con generosidad serán bendecidos. \q Comparten su comida con los pobres.

vi.L: [Người có] mắt lành sẽ được phước, \q vì người ấy chia bánh mình cho người nghèo.
vi.B: Người rộng rãi sẽ được phước, \q vì họ chia sẻ thức ăn với người nghèo.
vi.R: Người hay cho đi sẽ được phước. \q Họ chia sẻ thức ăn với người nghèo.

ko.L: 좋은 눈을 가진 자는 복을 받을 것이니, \q 자기 빵을 가난한 자에게 주기 때문이다.
ko.B: 너그러운 사람은 복을 받으니, \q 자기 먹을 것을 가난한 사람과 나누기 때문이다.
ko.R: 아낌없이 주는 사람은 복을 받을 것이다. \q 그들은 자기 먹을 것을 가난한 사람과 나눈다.

pt.L: [Quem tem] o olho bom será abençoado, \q pois dá do seu pão ao pobre.
pt.B: Quem é generoso será abençoado, \q porque reparte a sua comida com o pobre.
pt.R: Quem dá com generosidade vai ser abençoado. \q Essas pessoas repartem a comida com os pobres.

am.L: ዓይኑ መልካም የሆነ እርሱ ይባረካል፤ \q ከእንጀራው ለድሃ ይሰጣልና።
am.B: ለጋስ ሰው ይባረካል፤ \q ምግቡን ለድሃ ያካፍላልና።
am.R: በልግስና የሚሰጡ ሰዎች ይባረካሉ። \q ምግባቸውን ለድሆች ያካፍላሉ።

hi.L: भली आँखवाला आशीष पाएगा, \q क्योंकि वह अपनी रोटी में से ग़रीब को देता है।
hi.B: उदार लोग आशीष पाएँगे, \q क्योंकि वे अपना भोजन ग़रीबों के साथ बाँटते हैं।
hi.R: जो लोग खुले हाथ से देते हैं, उन्हें आशीष मिलेगी। \q वे अपना भोजन ग़रीब लोगों के साथ बाँटते हैं।

ru.L: [Имеющий] доброе око будет благословлён, \q потому что даёт из своего хлеба бедному.
ru.B: Щедрые будут благословлены, \q потому что делятся своим хлебом с бедными.
ru.R: Люди, которые щедро дают, будут благословлены. \q Они делятся едой с бедными.

uk.L: [Той, хто має] добре око, буде благословенний, \q бо він дає зі свого хліба бідному.
uk.B: Щедрі люди будуть благословенні, \q бо діляться своєю їжею з бідними.
uk.R: Люди, які щедро дають, будуть благословенні. \q Вони діляться своєю їжею з бідними людьми.

decisions.choice: good of eye: generous
decisions.reason: The "good eye" looks kindly on others and gives; the "evil eye" is stingy (23:6; 28:22).

decisions.choice: will be blessed: by God
decisions.reason: The passive leaves the one who blesses unnamed; the generous are rewarded as in 11:25 and 19:17.

decisions.choice: "भली आँखवाला"
decisions.reason: "Good of eye" is a Hebrew idiom for generous (meaning m1); Literal keeps the eye, as the English Literal does, and Balanced and Readable say "generous".

decisions.choice: доброе око
decisions.reason: A good eye means generosity (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, Balanced and Readable say "щедрые".

source.text: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְקָלֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Drive out a mocker, and strife will go out, and dispute and insult will cease.

en.L: Drive out [the] mocker, and strife will go out; \q quarreling and insult will cease.
en.B: Throw out the mocker, and conflict goes too; \q quarrels and insults come to an end.
en.R: Send away the mocker, and the fighting will leave too. \q The arguing and the insults will stop.

fr.L: Chasse [le] moqueur, et la querelle sortira ; \q la dispute et l’outrage cesseront.
fr.B: Mets le moqueur dehors, et le conflit s’en va avec lui ; \q les disputes et les insultes prennent fin.
fr.R: Renvoie le moqueur, et les bagarres partiront aussi. \q Les disputes et les insultes s’arrêteront.

sw.L: Mfukuze mwenye dharau, na ugomvi utatoka; \q mabishano na matusi yatakoma.
sw.B: Mtoe nje mwenye dharau, na mafarakano yataondoka pia; \q magomvi na matusi yatakwisha.
sw.R: Mfukuze mwenye dharau, na mapigano yataondoka pia. \q Mabishano na matusi yatakoma.

es.L: Echa fuera [al] burlón, y saldrá la contienda; \q cesarán el pleito y la afrenta.
es.B: Expulsa al burlón, y se irá también el conflicto; \q se acabarán los pleitos y los insultos.
es.R: Echa al que se burla de los demás, y las peleas se irán con él. \q Las discusiones y los insultos se acabarán.

vi.L: Hãy đuổi kẻ nhạo báng đi, thì sự xung đột sẽ ra đi; \q tranh cãi và sỉ nhục sẽ chấm dứt.
vi.B: Hãy tống cổ kẻ nhạo báng, thì xung đột cũng đi theo; \q cãi cọ và lăng mạ sẽ chấm dứt.
vi.R: Hãy đuổi kẻ nhạo báng đi, thì cãi vã cũng đi theo. \q Tranh cãi và lăng mạ sẽ ngừng.

ko.L: 비웃는 자를 쫓아내라, 그러면 다툼도 나갈 것이다. \q 싸움과 모욕이 그칠 것이다.
ko.B: 비웃는 자를 내쫓아라. 그러면 싸움도 사라지고, \q 다툼과 모욕도 끝난다.
ko.R: 남을 비웃는 사람을 내보내라. 그러면 싸움도 함께 나간다. \q 말다툼과 모욕도 멈출 것이다.

pt.L: Expulse o zombador, e a contenda sairá; \q cessarão a disputa e o insulto.
pt.B: Ponha o zombador para fora, e a briga vai junto; \q acabam as discussões e os insultos.
pt.R: Mande embora o zombador, e a briga também vai embora. \q As discussões e os insultos vão parar.

am.L: ፌዘኛን አስወጣ፤ ጠብም ይወጣል፤ \q ክርክርና ስድብም ይቀራል።
am.B: ፌዘኛን አባርረው፤ ጭቅጭቅም አብሮ ይሄዳል፤ \q ክርክርና ስድብም ያከትማል።
am.R: ፌዘኛውን አሰናብተው፤ ጠቡም አብሮ ይሄዳል። \q ጭቅጭቁና ስድቡም ይቆማል።

hi.L: ठट्ठा करनेवाले को निकाल दो, तो झगड़ा निकल जाएगा; \q और वाद-विवाद और अपमान बंद हो जाएँगे।
hi.B: ठट्ठा करनेवाले को बाहर निकालो, तो लड़ाई भी चली जाती है; \q झगड़े और अपमान ख़त्म हो जाते हैं।
hi.R: दूसरों का मज़ाक़ उड़ानेवाले को भेज दो, तो लड़ाई भी चली जाएगी। \q बहस और अपमान रुक जाएँगे।

ru.L: Прогони насмешника — и уйдёт раздор, \q и прекратятся тяжба и бесчестье.
ru.B: Выгони насмешника — и вместе с ним уйдут раздоры; \q прекратятся ссоры и оскорбления.
ru.R: Прогони насмешника, и ссоры уйдут вместе с ним. \q Споры и оскорбления прекратятся.

uk.L: Прожени насмішника — і вийде сварка, \q і припиняться суперечка й зневага.
uk.B: Вижени насмішника — і чвари підуть разом із ним; \q сварки й образи припиняться.
uk.R: Прожени насмішника, і сварки теж підуть. \q Суперечки й образи припиняться.

decisions.choice: mocker: one who scorns correction and others
decisions.reason: The mocker (lets) sneers at wisdom and stirs up trouble (21:24; 26:20).

decisions.choice: dispute and insult: quarrels and the shame they bring
decisions.reason: The word for dispute (din) can mean a court case. Insult (qalon) is the dishonor heaped on people in a quarrel.

decisions.choice: the mocker (lets) as "ፌዘኛ"
decisions.reason: The terms list's word: "ፌዘኛ" is the one who scoffs and sneers at others and at correction, which is what the lets does in Proverbs; "ዋዘኛ" is only a joker.

source.text: אֹהֵ֥ב טְהָר־לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו רֵעֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: [One who] loves purity of heart, grace [is in] his lips, his friend [is] a king.

en.L: Whoever loves purity of heart \q [and has] grace on {{gender:their|his}} lips, the king [is] {{gender:their|his}} friend.
en.B: Whoever loves a pure heart \q and speaks with grace will have the king for a friend.
en.R: Love what is pure, and speak kindly. \q Then even the king will want to be your friend.

fr.L: Qui aime la pureté du cœur \q [et a] la grâce sur ses lèvres, le roi [est] son ami.
fr.B: Celui qui aime un cœur pur \q et parle avec grâce aura le roi pour ami.
fr.R: Aime ce qui est pur et parle avec bonté. \q Alors même le roi voudra être ton ami.

sw.L: Apendaye usafi wa moyo \q [na mwenye] neema midomoni mwake, mfalme [ni] rafiki yake.
sw.B: Anayependa moyo safi \q na kusema kwa neema atakuwa na mfalme kama rafiki.
sw.R: Penda yaliyo safi, na useme kwa upole. \q Ndipo hata mfalme atakapotaka kuwa rafiki yako.

es.L: Quien ama la pureza de corazón \q [y tiene] gracia en sus labios, el rey [es] su amigo.
es.B: Quien ama un corazón puro \q y habla con gracia tendrá al rey por amigo.
es.R: Ama lo que es puro y habla con amabilidad. \q Entonces hasta el rey querrá ser tu amigo.

vi.L: Ai yêu sự trong sạch của lòng \q [và có] ân hậu trên môi mình, vua [là] bạn của người ấy.
vi.B: Ai yêu tấm lòng trong sạch \q và nói năng ân hậu sẽ được vua làm bạn.
vi.R: Hãy yêu điều trong sạch và nói năng tử tế. \q Rồi ngay cả vua cũng muốn làm bạn với bạn.

ko.L: 마음의 깨끗함을 사랑하고 \q 입술에 은혜가 [있는] 자는 왕이 그의 친구이다.
ko.B: 깨끗한 마음을 사랑하고 \q 은혜롭게 말하는 사람은 왕과 친구가 된다.
ko.R: 깨끗한 것을 사랑하고 친절하게 말하여라. \q 그러면 왕도 너와 친구가 되고 싶어 할 것이다.

pt.L: Quem ama a pureza de coração \q [e tem] graça nos seus lábios, o rei [é] seu amigo.
pt.B: Quem ama um coração puro \q e fala com graça terá o rei como amigo.
pt.R: Ame o que é puro e fale com bondade. \q Então até o rei vai querer ser seu amigo.

am.L: የልብ ንጽሕናን የሚወድድ \q [እና] በከንፈሩ ሞገስ [ያለው]፣ ንጉሥ ወዳጁ [ነው]።
am.B: ንጹሕ ልብን የሚወድድ \q በጸጋም የሚናገር ንጉሥ ወዳጅ ይሆነዋል።
am.R: ንጹሕ የሆነውን ውደድ፤ በደግነትም ተናገር። \q ያን ጊዜ ንጉሥ እንኳ ወዳጅህ ሊሆን ይፈልጋል።

hi.L: जो मन की शुद्धता से प्रेम रखता है \q [और जिसके] होंठों पर अनुग्रह [है], राजा उसका मित्र [होता है]।
hi.B: जो शुद्ध मन से प्रेम रखता है \q और कृपा से बोलता है, राजा उसका मित्र होगा।
hi.R: जो शुद्ध है, उससे प्रेम करो, और दयालुता से बोलो। \q तब राजा भी तुम्हारा मित्र बनना चाहेगा।

ru.L: Любящий чистоту сердца, \q [у кого] благодать на устах, — царь ему друг.
ru.B: Кто любит чистое сердце \q и говорит с добротой, тому царь будет другом.
ru.R: Люби то, что чисто, и говори по-доброму. \q Тогда даже царь захочет с тобой дружить.

uk.L: Хто любить чистоту серця \q [і має] благодать на своїх губах, — цар його друг.
uk.B: Хто любить чисте серце \q і говорить привітно, матиме царя за друга.
uk.R: Люби чисте й говори лагідно. \q Тоді навіть цар захоче з тобою дружити.

decisions.choice: pure, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the king befriends the pure in heart who speak graciously
alternatives: the king loves the pure in heart; one gracious in speech has him as friend
decisions.reason: The words are loosely joined, and the line can be divided in more than one way. The sense is that integrity and gracious speech win a ruler's favor (16:13). The Greek translation has the LORD, not a king, loving pure hearts.

decisions.choice: "अनुग्रह" (grace on the lips)
decisions.reason: Grace on the lips is gracious speech that wins favour (meaning m2); Literal keeps "अनुग्रह" in the sense of graciousness, as the English Literal keeps "grace", and Balanced says "speaks with grace".

decisions.choice: благодать
decisions.reason: Hen on the lips is graciousness of speech (m2); Literal keeps "благодать" as the English keeps "grace", Balanced says "с добротой".

source.text: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: The eyes of YHWH guard knowledge, and he overturns [the] words of [one who] acts treacherously.

en.L: The eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} guard knowledge, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} overturns [the] words of [the] treacherous.
en.B: The eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} keep watch over knowledge, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings the words of the faithless to nothing.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} watches over what is true. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} ruins the plans of people who lie.

fr.L: Les yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} gardent la connaissance, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} renverse [les] paroles du traître.
fr.B: Les yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} veillent sur la connaissance, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} réduit à néant les paroles des infidèles.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veille sur ce qui est vrai. \q Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait échouer les projets des menteurs.

sw.L: Macho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hulinda maarifa, \q bali huyapindua maneno ya mdanganyifu.
sw.B: Macho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huyalinda maarifa, \q bali huyabatilisha maneno ya wasio waaminifu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hulinda yaliyo kweli. \q Lakini huiharibu mipango ya watu waongo.

es.L: Los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} guardan el conocimiento, \q pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} trastorna [las] palabras del traidor.
es.B: Los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vigilan el conocimiento, \q pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} reduce a nada las palabras del infiel.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} protege lo que es verdad. \q Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} arruina los planes de los mentirosos.

vi.L: Mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gìn giữ tri thức, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lật đổ lời của kẻ phản trắc.
vi.B: Mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} canh giữ tri thức, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho lời kẻ bội tín ra hư không.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} canh giữ điều chân thật. \q Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phá hỏng kế hoạch của kẻ nói dối.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈은 지식을 지키지만, \q 배신하는 자의 말은 뒤엎으신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈은 지식을 지켜보시지만, \q 신실하지 못한 자의 말은 헛되게 하신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 참된 것을 지켜 주신다. \q 그러나 거짓말하는 사람의 계획은 망하게 하신다.

pt.L: Os olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} guardam o conhecimento, \q mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} transtorna as palavras do traidor.
pt.B: Os olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} protegem o conhecimento, \q mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} reduz a nada as palavras do infiel.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} protege o que é verdadeiro. \q Mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} arruína os planos de quem mente.

am.L: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ዓይኖች እውቀትን ይጠብቃሉ፤ \q የከሃዲውን ቃል ግን ይገለብጣል።
am.B: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ዓይኖች እውቀትን ይጠብቃሉ፤ \q የከሃዲዎችን ቃል ግን ከንቱ ያደርጋል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እውነት የሆነውን ይጠብቃል። \q የሚዋሹ ሰዎችን ዕቅድ ግን ያፈርሳል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आँखें ज्ञान की रक्षा करती हैं, \q पर वे विश्वासघाती की बातों को उलट देते हैं।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आँखें ज्ञान पर नज़र रखती हैं, \q पर वे विश्वासघातियों की बातों को निष्फल कर देते हैं।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सच्चाई की रक्षा करते हैं। \q पर झूठ बोलनेवालों की योजनाओं को वे बिगाड़ देते हैं।

ru.L: Очи {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} охраняют знание, \q а слова вероломного {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} опрокидывает.
ru.B: Очи {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} оберегают знание, \q а слова вероломных {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} обращает в ничто.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} бережёт то, что истинно. \q А замыслы лжецов {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} разрушает.

uk.L: Очі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІ|Ягве}} стережуть знання, \q а слова зрадливого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} перекидає.
uk.B: Очі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІ|Ягве}} пильнують знання, \q а слова невірних {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} обертає на ніщо.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} оберігає те, що правдиве. \q А задуми людей, які брешуть, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} руйнує.

decisions.choice: knowledge: true knowledge and those who hold it
decisions.reason: The LORD protects what is true and the one who speaks it, in contrast to the treacherous in the second line.

decisions.choice: overturns: subverts, frustrates
decisions.reason: The verb (sillef) is used of the LORD overthrowing the wicked (13:6; 21:12) and of folly twisting a life (19:3).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; honorific "वे" for God
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7). Respect for God is carried by the honorific plural "वे", as in the earlier books of this translation. This holds wherever the English has such a span in this chapter.

source.text: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל אֲרִ֣י בַח֑וּץ בְּת֥וֹךְ רְ֝חֹב֗וֹת אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Says [the] sluggard, A lion [is] outside! In [the] middle of [the] streets I will be killed!

en.L: [The] sluggard says, "[There is] a lion outside! \q I will be killed in [the] middle of the streets!"
en.B: The lazy one says, "A lion is out there! \q I will be murdered in the open street!"
en.R: A lazy person says, "I cannot go out. There is a lion out there! \q It will kill me in the street!"

fr.L: [Le] paresseux dit : « [Il y a] un lion dehors ! \q Je serai tué au milieu des rues ! »
fr.B: Le paresseux dit : « Il y a un lion dehors ! \q Je vais me faire tuer en pleine rue ! »
fr.R: Le paresseux dit : « Je ne peux pas sortir. Il y a un lion dehors ! \q Il va me tuer dans la rue ! »

sw.L: Mvivu husema, "[Kuna] simba nje! \q Nitauawa katikati ya njia kuu!"
sw.B: Mvivu husema, "Kuna simba huko nje! \q Nitauawa barabarani!"
sw.R: Mtu mvivu husema, "Siwezi kutoka nje. Kuna simba huko! \q Atanirarua barabarani!"

es.L: [El] perezoso dice: «¡[Hay] un león afuera! \q ¡Me matarán en medio de las calles!»
es.B: El perezoso dice: «¡Hay un león ahí fuera! \q ¡Me van a asesinar en plena calle!»
es.R: Un perezoso dice: «No puedo salir. ¡Hay un león ahí afuera! \q ¡Me va a matar en la calle!»

vi.L: Kẻ lười biếng nói: "[Có] sư tử ngoài kia! \q Ta sẽ bị giết giữa đường phố!"
vi.B: Kẻ lười biếng nói: "Có sư tử ngoài kia! \q Tôi sẽ bị giết ngay giữa phố!"
vi.R: Người lười biếng nói: "Tôi không thể ra ngoài. Có sư tử ngoài đó! \q Nó sẽ giết tôi ngoài đường mất!"

ko.L: 게으른 자는 말한다. "밖에 사자가 [있다]! \q 거리 한가운데서 내가 죽임을 당할 것이다!"
ko.B: 게으른 사람은 말한다. "밖에 사자가 있다! \q 거리에서 내가 죽고 말 거야!"
ko.R: 게으른 사람은 이렇게 말한다. "나는 못 나가. 밖에 사자가 있어! \q 길에서 사자에게 잡아먹힐 거야!"

pt.L: O preguiçoso diz: "[Há] um leão lá fora! \q No meio das ruas serei morto!"
pt.B: O preguiçoso diz: "Há um leão lá fora! \q Vou ser assassinado no meio da rua!"
pt.R: O preguiçoso diz: "Não posso sair. Há um leão lá fora! \q Ele vai me matar na rua!"

am.L: ታካች እንዲህ ይላል፦ «በውጭ አንበሳ [አለ]! \q በአደባባዮች መካከል እገደላለሁ!»
am.B: ታካች እንዲህ ይላል፦ «አንበሳ በውጭ አለ! \q በአደባባይ ላይ እገደላለሁ!»
am.R: ታካች ሰው እንዲህ ይላል፦ «መውጣት አልችልም፤ በውጭ አንበሳ አለ! \q በመንገድ ላይ ይገድለኛል!»

hi.L: आलसी कहता है, "बाहर सिंह [है]! \q चौकों के बीच मैं मार डाला जाऊँगा!"
hi.B: आलसी कहता है, "बाहर सिंह है! \q खुली सड़क पर मेरा ख़ून हो जाएगा!"
hi.R: आलसी व्यक्ति कहता है, "मैं बाहर नहीं जा सकता। बाहर सिंह है! \q वह मुझे सड़क पर ही मार डालेगा!"

ru.L: Говорит ленивец: «Лев снаружи! \q Посреди улиц я буду убит!»
ru.B: Ленивец говорит: «Там лев! \q Меня убьют прямо на улице!»
ru.R: Ленивый человек говорит: «Я не могу выйти. Там, снаружи, лев! \q Он убьёт меня на улице!»

uk.L: Ледар каже: «Лев надворі! \q Посеред вулиць мене вбʼють!»
uk.B: Лінивий каже: «Там лев! \q Мене вбʼють посеред вулиці!»
uk.R: Ледачий каже: «Я не можу вийти. Там лев! \q Він мене вбʼє на вулиці!»

decisions.choice: a lion outside: an absurd excuse to stay home
decisions.reason: The lazy one invents a danger to avoid going out to work (26:13). The verb for being killed (ratsah) is the word usually used of murder, which adds to the comedy.

decisions.choice: I cannot go out
decisions.reason: Readable states the point of the excuse, as in 26:13.

decisions.choice: assassinado
decisions.reason: ratsah is the word for murder (m1), so Balanced says "assassinado", which keeps the comedy of a lion committing murder. 26:13 tells the same excuse in other words; its drafter can match "Há um leão" and "no meio da rua" where the Hebrew agrees.

decisions.choice: the sluggard (ʿatsel) as "ታካች"
decisions.reason: In modern Amharic "ሰነፍ" first means lazy, but in Proverbs it is kept for the fool ʾewil, as the terms list sets; the sluggard is "ታካች" at every level so the two never meet. 26:13 repeats this saying and keeps this wording.

decisions.choice: "आलसी"
decisions.reason: The sluggard keeps the form of 19:24; his lion is an absurd excuse to stay at home (meaning m1), and the words are kept as he says them.

decisions.choice: ленивец
decisions.reason: Atsel is "ленивец" at Literal and Balanced, as 10:26 and 19:24; the same excuse returns at 26:13.

source.text: שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקָּה פִּ֣י זָר֑וֹת זְע֥וּם יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִפָּל־שָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: A pit deep [is the] mouth of strange [women]; [one] cursed [by] YHWH will fall there.

en.L: [The] mouth of strange [women is] a deep pit; \q [one who is] cursed [by] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will fall into it.
en.B: The talk of forbidden women is a deep pit; \q anyone {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is angry with will fall into it.
en.R: The sweet words of an immoral woman are like a deep pit. \q People {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is angry with will fall into it.

fr.L: [La] bouche des étrangères [est] une fosse profonde ; \q [celui qui est] maudit [par] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} y tombera.
fr.B: Les paroles de la femme étrangère sont une fosse profonde ; \q celui contre qui {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est irrité y tombera.
fr.R: Les douces paroles de la femme d’un autre sont comme une fosse profonde. \q Ceux contre qui {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est en colère y tomberont.

sw.L: Kinywa cha wanawake wageni [ni] shimo refu; \q [yule] aliyelaaniwa [na] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataanguka humo.
sw.B: Maneno ya wanawake wa watu wengine ni shimo refu; \q yeyote ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemkasirikia ataanguka humo.
sw.R: Maneno matamu ya mke wa mtu mwingine ni kama shimo refu. \q Watu ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewakasirikia wataanguka humo.

es.L: [La] boca de [las mujeres] ajenas [es] fosa profunda; \q [el que es] maldito [por] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} caerá en ella.
es.B: Las palabras de las mujeres ajenas son una fosa profunda; \q caerá en ella aquel contra quien {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está enojado.
es.R: Las palabras dulces de la mujer de otro son como un pozo profundo. \q Caerán en él las personas con quienes {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está enojado.

vi.L: Miệng của những người đàn bà lạ [là] hố sâu; \q [kẻ bị] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận sẽ sa vào đó.
vi.B: Lời của những người đàn bà lạ là hố sâu; \q ai bị {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận sẽ sa vào đó.
vi.R: Lời ngọt ngào của vợ người khác giống như hố sâu. \q Người bị {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận sẽ sa vào đó.

ko.L: 낯선 여자들의 입은 깊은 구덩이이니, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 저주받은 자가 거기에 빠질 것이다.
ko.B: 낯선 여자의 말은 깊은 구덩이여서, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 노여워하시는 사람이 거기에 빠진다.
ko.R: 남의 아내가 하는 달콤한 말은 깊은 구덩이와 같다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 노여워하시는 사람이 거기에 빠진다.

pt.L: Cova profunda [é] a boca das [mulheres] estranhas; \q o amaldiçoado {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}} cairá ali.
pt.B: A conversa das mulheres alheias é uma cova profunda; \q quem está debaixo da ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} cai nela.
pt.R: As palavras doces de uma mulher que pertence a outro homem são como uma cova funda. \q As pessoas com quem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} está irado caem nela.

am.L: የባዕዳን ሴቶች አፍ ጥልቅ ጉድጓድ [ነው]፤ \q {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} የተረገመ [ሰው] በዚያ ይወድቃል።
am.B: የአመንዝራ ሴቶች ንግግር ጥልቅ ጉድጓድ ነው፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተቆጣበት ሰው ይወድቅበታል።
am.R: የአመንዝራ ሴት ጣፋጭ ቃል እንደ ጥልቅ ጉድጓድ ነው። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተቆጣባቸው ሰዎች ይወድቁበታል።

hi.L: पराई स्त्रियों का मुँह गहरा गड्ढा [है]; \q जिस पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का कोप [है], वह उसमें गिरेगा।
hi.B: वर्जित स्त्रियों की बातें गहरा गड्ढा हैं; \q जिस पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} क्रोधित हैं, वह उसमें गिर पड़ेगा।
hi.R: व्यभिचारिणी स्त्री की मीठी बातें गहरे गड्ढे के समान हैं। \q जिन लोगों पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} क्रोधित हैं, वे उसमें गिर पड़ेंगे।

ru.L: Глубокая яма — уста чужих жён; \q на кого гневается {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, тот упадёт туда.
ru.B: Речи запретных женщин — глубокая яма; \q кто прогневал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, тот упадёт в неё.
ru.R: Сладкие слова распутной женщины подобны глубокой яме. \q Люди, на которых гневается {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, упадут в неё.

uk.L: Уста чужих [жінок] — глибока яма; \q проклятий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}} упаде туди.
uk.B: Мова заборонених жінок — глибока яма; \q у неї впаде кожен, на кого гнівається {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Солодкі слова розпусної жінки — як глибока яма. \q Люди, на яких гнівається {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, упадуть у неї.

decisions.choice: the mouth of strange women: the seductive talk of women outside one's marriage
decisions.reason: The strange woman (zarah) belongs to another man; her smooth speech draws men in (2:16; 5:3; 7:5, 21).

decisions.choice: cursed by the LORD: the one under his indignation
decisions.reason: The word (zaam) is anger expressed in judgment. Falling into the pit is itself the judgment on such a person (Ecclesiastes 7:26).

decisions.choice: will fall, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: "les étrangères" at Literal, "la femme étrangère" at Balanced, "la femme d'un autre" at Readable
alternatives: "la femme immorale", as the English Readable "an immoral woman"
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for the strange woman of Proverbs 2, 5 and 7: a woman outside one's marriage. Readable says plainly whose wife she is, as the note sets for the whole book.

decisions.choice: "wanawake wageni" (L), "wanawake wa watu wengine" (B), "mke wa mtu mwingine" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms for Proverbs give "mwanamke mgeni" for the strange woman and "mke wa mtu mwingine" at Readable; she belongs to another man (meaning decision m1). Balanced says the same thing in the plural, as the English "forbidden women" does.

decisions.choice: las mujeres ajenas (L, B); la mujer de otro (R)
decisions.reason: The strange woman (zarah) is a woman outside one's marriage, another man's wife. 'Ajena', 'belonging to someone else', says that in ordinary Spanish; Readable says it outright, 'la mujer de otro', rather than the English Readable's 'immoral woman', following the terms used for the strange woman throughout Proverbs.

decisions.choice: "người đàn bà lạ" (L, B); "vợ người khác" (R)
decisions.reason: The shared terms list gives these words for the strange woman of chapters 2-7, and this saying is about her (see the meaning decision). Readable says plainly who she is, as the list has it, where the English Readable says "an immoral woman".

decisions.choice: "낯선 여자" (L, B); "남의 아내" (R) for the strange woman
decisions.reason: As the terms note: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew's "strange", a woman outside one's marriage (meaning decision m1); Readable says plainly who she is. "음녀" is an older word that names her by her sin rather than by what the Hebrew calls her.

decisions.choice: strange women (zarot) as "ባዕዳን ሴቶች" (Literal), "አመንዝራ ሴቶች" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets: Literal keeps the Hebrew's "strange", Balanced and Readable say what is meant, as the English "forbidden" and "immoral".

decisions.choice: "पराई स्त्रियों" (L); "वर्जित स्त्रियों" (B); "व्यभिचारिणी स्त्री" (R)
decisions.reason: The strange women are women outside one's marriage, and their mouth is their seductive talk (meaning m1). As the poetry note settles, Literal says "पराई स्त्री" and the other levels follow the English level: "forbidden" at Balanced, "immoral" at Readable.

decisions.choice: чужих жён
decisions.reason: The strange woman is "чужая жена" at Literal, as the poetry note and 2:16 settle; Balanced says "запретные женщины", as the English says "forbidden women".

source.text: אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְלֶב־נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥נָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Folly [is] bound in [the] heart of a youth; [the] rod of discipline will make it far from him.

en.L: Folly [is] bound up in [the] heart of a child; \q [the] rod of discipline will drive it far from {{gender:them|him}}.
en.B: Foolishness is tied fast to a child's heart, \q but the rod of discipline will drive it far away.
en.R: Children are naturally foolish. \q Firm correction will drive that foolishness out of them.

fr.L: La folie [est] attachée au cœur de l’enfant ; \q la verge de la discipline l’éloignera de lui.
fr.B: La folie est solidement liée au cœur de l’enfant, \q mais le bâton de la discipline la chassera loin de lui.
fr.R: Les enfants font naturellement des bêtises. \q Une correction ferme chassera cette folie loin d’eux.

sw.L: Upumbavu umefungwa moyoni mwa kijana; \q fimbo ya nidhamu itauweka mbali naye.
sw.B: Upumbavu umefungwa kwa nguvu moyoni mwa mtoto, \q bali fimbo ya nidhamu itaufukuza mbali.
sw.R: Watoto kwa asili huwa na upumbavu. \q Marekebisho thabiti yataufukuza upumbavu huo kutoka kwao.

es.L: La necedad [está] atada al corazón del muchacho; \q la vara de la disciplina la alejará de él.
es.B: La necedad está bien amarrada al corazón del niño, \q pero la vara de la disciplina la echará lejos.
es.R: Los niños hacen tonterías por naturaleza. \q Una corrección firme sacará de ellos esa necedad.

vi.L: Sự ngu dại buộc chặt trong lòng đứa trẻ; \q roi sửa dạy sẽ đuổi nó xa khỏi đứa trẻ.
vi.B: Sự dại dột buộc chặt vào lòng con trẻ, \q nhưng roi sửa dạy sẽ đuổi nó đi xa.
vi.R: Trẻ con tự nhiên có tính dại dột. \q Sự sửa dạy nghiêm khắc sẽ đuổi tính dại dột ấy ra khỏi các em.

ko.L: 미련함이 아이의 마음에 얽매여 있으나, \q 훈계의 매가 그것을 그에게서 멀리 쫓아낼 것이다.
ko.B: 미련함은 아이의 마음에 단단히 묶여 있지만, \q 훈계의 매가 그것을 멀리 쫓아낸다.
ko.R: 아이들은 원래 미련하다. \q 엄하게 바로잡아 주면 그 미련함이 떠나갈 것이다.

pt.L: A tolice [está] amarrada no coração da criança; \q a vara da disciplina a lançará para longe dela.
pt.B: A tolice está bem amarrada ao coração da criança, \q mas a vara da disciplina a manda para longe.
pt.R: As crianças são tolas por natureza. \q A correção firme vai tirar delas essa tolice.

am.L: ስንፍና በልጅ ልብ የታሰረ [ነው]፤ \q የተግሣጽ በትር ከእርሱ ያርቀዋል።
am.B: ስንፍና በልጅ ልብ ውስጥ አጥብቆ ታስሯል፤ \q የተግሣጽ በትር ግን ከእርሱ ያርቀዋል።
am.R: የልጅ ልብ በተፈጥሮው ወደ ስንፍና ያዘነብላል። \q ጠንከር ያለ ተግሣጽ ያን ስንፍና ከእርሱ ያወጣዋል።

hi.L: मूर्खता बालक के मन में बँधी [रहती है]; \q अनुशासन की छड़ी उसे उससे दूर कर देगी।
hi.B: मूर्खता बच्चे के मन से कसकर बँधी होती है, \q पर अनुशासन की छड़ी उसे दूर भगा देगी।
hi.R: बच्चों में मूर्खता स्वाभाविक रूप से होती है। \q दृढ़ता से सुधारने पर वह मूर्खता उनसे दूर हो जाएगी।

ru.L: Глупость привязана к сердцу ребёнка; \q жезл наставления удалит её от него.
ru.B: Глупость крепко привязана к сердцу ребёнка, \q но розга наставления прогонит её прочь.
ru.R: Дети от природы бывают глупыми. \q Твёрдое вразумление изгонит из них эту глупость.

uk.L: Безумство привʼязане до серця дитини; \q різка настанови віддалить його від неї.
uk.B: Нерозумність міцно привʼязана до дитячого серця, \q але різка настанови прожене її далеко.
uk.R: Діти від природи нерозумні. \q Тверде виправлення прожене з них цю нерозумність.

decisions.choice: the rod: physical discipline
decisions.reason: The rod was the usual means of correcting a child in the ancient world (13:24; 23:13–14; 29:15). The point of the saying is that love corrects; the means belongs to its time and must be read in the light of all Scripture says about love and justice.

decisions.choice: folly bound in the heart: foolishness comes naturally to the young
decisions.reason: Folly (ivvelet) is tied to the young heart like a knot (compare 1:22). Correction loosens it.

decisions.choice: firm correction
decisions.reason: Readable gives the purpose of the rod in plain words; the footnote on the meaning decision explains the picture.

decisions.choice: folly (ʾivvelet) as "ስንፍና"; discipline (musar) as "ተግሣጽ"
decisions.reason: "ስንፍና" is the noun of "ሰነፍ", the terms list's word for the fool ʾewil, so the fool and his folly share a root as in the Hebrew; "ሞኝነት" is kept for kesilut, the folly of the kesil ("ሞኝ"). "ተግሣጽ" is the terms list's word for musar, correction that trains.

decisions.choice: наставление (L, B); вразумление (R)
decisions.reason: Musar as the poetry note settles; the rod (m1) carries the physical side.

source.text: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל לְהַרְבּ֣וֹת ל֑וֹ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: [One who] oppresses [the] poor to increase for himself, [one who] gives to a rich [one]—only to want.

en.L: Whoever oppresses [the] poor to gain more for {{gender:themselves|himself}}, \q [or] gives to [the] rich, [comes] only to want.
en.B: Whoever exploits the poor to get rich, \q or hands gifts to the rich, will only end up in need.
en.R: Some people cheat the poor to get rich. \q Others give gifts to rich people to win favor. \q Both will end up poor.

fr.L: Qui opprime [le] pauvre pour s’enrichir, \q [ou] donne au riche, [n’arrive] qu’à la disette.
fr.B: Qui exploite le pauvre pour s’enrichir, \q ou fait des cadeaux au riche, finira dans le besoin.
fr.R: Certains trichent avec les pauvres pour devenir riches. \q D’autres font des cadeaux aux riches pour gagner leur faveur. \q Les uns et les autres finiront pauvres.

sw.L: Amwoneaye maskini ili ajiongezee, \q [au] ampaye tajiri, [huishia] kupungukiwa tu.
sw.B: Anayewadhulumu maskini ili atajirike, \q au anayewapa matajiri zawadi, ataishia katika uhitaji tu.
sw.R: Watu wengine huwadanganya maskini ili wapate utajiri. \q Wengine huwapa matajiri zawadi ili wapendelewe. \q Wote wawili wataishia kuwa maskini.

es.L: Quien oprime al pobre para aumentar lo suyo, \q [o] da al rico, [llega] solo a la escasez.
es.B: Quien explota al pobre para enriquecerse, \q o hace regalos al rico, solo acabará en la necesidad.
es.R: Algunos engañan a los pobres para hacerse ricos. \q Otros les hacen regalos a los ricos para ganarse su favor. \q Los dos terminarán pobres.

vi.L: Ai áp bức người nghèo để làm giàu cho mình, \q [hoặc] cho người giàu, chỉ [đi] đến thiếu thốn.
vi.B: Kẻ bóc lột người nghèo để làm giàu, \q hay đem quà biếu người giàu, rốt cuộc chỉ đi đến túng thiếu.
vi.R: Có kẻ gian lận với người nghèo để làm giàu. \q Có kẻ đem quà biếu người giàu để được lòng họ. \q Cả hai rồi sẽ nghèo.

ko.L: 자기를 위해 더 얻으려고 가난한 자를 억누르는 자나, \q 부자에게 주는 자는 오직 궁핍에 [이른다].
ko.B: 부자가 되려고 가난한 사람을 착취하는 사람이나 \q 부자에게 선물을 갖다 바치는 사람은 결국 궁핍해진다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람은 부자가 되려고 가난한 사람을 속인다. \q 어떤 사람은 잘 보이려고 부자에게 선물을 준다. \q 그 둘 다 결국 가난해질 것이다.

pt.L: Quem oprime o pobre para aumentar para si, \q [ou] dá ao rico, [chega] só à falta.
pt.B: Quem explora o pobre para enriquecer, \q ou dá presentes ao rico, só acaba na necessidade.
pt.R: Há quem engane os pobres para ficar rico. \q Outros dão presentes aos ricos para ganhar favores. \q Os dois vão acabar pobres.

am.L: ለራሱ ለማብዛት ድሃን የሚያስጨንቅ፣ \q [ወይም] ለሀብታም የሚሰጥ፣ ወደ ችግር ብቻ [ይደርሳል]።
am.B: ለመበልጸግ ድሃን የሚበዘብዝ፣ \q ወይም ለሀብታም ስጦታ የሚሰጥ መጨረሻው ችግር ብቻ ነው።
am.R: አንዳንዶች ለመበልጸግ ድሆችን ያታልላሉ። \q ሌሎች ደግሞ ሞገስ ለማግኘት ለሀብታሞች ስጦታ ይሰጣሉ። \q የሁለቱም መጨረሻ ድህነት ነው።

hi.L: जो अपने लिए अधिक कमाने को ग़रीब पर अंधेर करता है, \q [या] धनी को देता है, [वह] केवल घटी में [पड़ता है]।
hi.B: जो धनी बनने के लिए ग़रीबों का शोषण करता है, \q या धनवानों को उपहार देता है, वह अंत में तंगी में ही पड़ेगा।
hi.R: कुछ लोग धनी बनने के लिए ग़रीबों को ठगते हैं। \q कुछ लोग कृपा पाने के लिए धनी लोगों को उपहार देते हैं। \q दोनों अंत में ग़रीब हो जाएँगे।

ru.L: Угнетающий бедного, чтобы умножить своё, \q [и] дающий богатому — [придут] только к нужде.
ru.B: Кто притесняет бедного, чтобы разбогатеть, \q или делает подарки богатому, тот лишь обеднеет.
ru.R: Одни обманывают бедных, чтобы разбогатеть. \q Другие делают подарки богатым, чтобы добиться их расположения. \q И те и другие обеднеют.

uk.L: Хто гнобить бідного, щоб примножити собі, \q [чи] дає багатому, — [дійде] лише до нестачі.
uk.B: Хто визискує бідних, щоб розбагатіти, \q чи підносить дарунки багатим, зрештою опиниться в нужді.
uk.R: Деякі люди ошукують бідних, щоб розбагатіти. \q Інші дарують подарунки багатим, щоб здобути прихильність. \q І ті, й ті зрештою збідніють.

decisions.choice: both oppressing the poor and giving to the rich end in want
alternatives: one who oppresses the poor may gain, but one who gives to the rich ends in want
one who oppresses the poor to enrich himself will end up giving to the rich, and so in want
decisions.reason: The two phrases are set side by side with no joining word, and their relation is unclear. Read as a pair, both ways of seeking gain backfire (11:24; 28:8).

decisions.choice: to win favor
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likely reason for gifts to the rich (19:6).
